known_risks: a provider's registered office is often its accountant's address, so many twins are unreachable by district blocking; recall_all carries that cost honestly
the word filter's COMMON list was chosen by hand before scoring, from general business words
CQC may record a stale or wrong company number; key errors count as model errors
companies that share a name and district (group companies) are hard for both arms
the engine scored 1,971 districts with its own backend; runtime 27 minutes
question: Can arche's engine, as shipped, link CQC providers to their Companies House company from name and address alone, clearly better than exact name matching and at least 99% precise?

arms.exact: folded name equal ('limited' read as 'ltd', punctuation dropped) against every company in the district, unique there

rule.blocking: postcode district of the provider = district of the registered office; within it, companies sharing a distinctive name word (3+ letters, outside build_uk_ch.COMMON) with some provider in the district
rule.interpretation: pass: arche is fit to link a register of UK organisations to Companies House by name and address, with the stated reach. fail: report which bound.
rule.lists: CQC HSCA active locations (2026-11-02): one record per provider with ownership type 'Organisation' and a Companies House number (25,840); Companies House BasicCompanyData 2026-11-01, every company
rule.metrics: precision = links to the provider's own company / links of providers whose company is in the file (with Wilson 95%); recall_all = providers linked to their own company / providers whose company is in the file; recall_reachable = same over providers whose company is in their district and passes the first pass
rule.one_to_one: per district, both arms: links taken by descending score, a provider keeps one company and a company one provider
rule.pass: engine precision >= 0.99 with Wilson lower bound >= 0.985, and engine recall_all >= exact recall_all + 0.10
rule.records: CQC: provider name; address = street, line 2, city, postcode; provider lat/lon. Companies House: company name; address = registered office lines 1-2, post town, postcode; ONSPD postcode centroid. Company numbers never reach the engine
secondary: unreachable providers by reason (not in file, registered elsewhere, no shared distinctive word)
engine review pairs and how many hold the twin
rule.truth: company number recorded by CQC for the provider (zero-padded to 8)
